study_title: Fitted-Operator Geometry as a Complementary Descriptive Axis for Brain-State Discrimination in Human iEEG and Scalp EEG
status_note: This file freezes the public repository analysis contract. It is not a claim that every analysis was externally preregistered before data inspection. Exploratory analyses must remain labeled exploratory.
pipeline_name: Fitted operator geometry using sliding-window VAR(1) models

frozen_parameters.operator_model: Sliding-window first-order vector autoregressive model; preprocessing differs by recording modality as documented in the manuscript and provenance file
frozen_parameters.legacy_ep_score_definition: Historical per-window proximity score stored in legacy result keys: eigenvector_overlap / (minimum_eigenvalue_gap + 1e-10).
frozen_parameters.current_manuscript_nd_definition: Near-Degeneracy score constructed from eigenvalue crowding c=-log10(gap+epsilon) and eigenvector non-orthogonality k=log10(condition_number+epsilon), standardized within the declared analysis unit and projected onto the first principal component with sign normalized to positive loadings.
frozen_parameters.metric_equivalence_warning: The legacy ep_score and final manuscript ND score are not the same statistic and must not be relabeled as equivalent.
frozen_parameters.subject_boundary_rule: All predictive cross-validation preserves subject identity; no subject appears in both training and evaluation folds
frozen_parameters.cohort_selection_rule: Canonical primary intracranial reproduction uses the fixed 18-subject manifest in cohorts/cogitate_primary.json and must not infer the scientific cohort from local directory contents.
frozen_parameters.strict_failure_rule: Canonical reproduction fails if any expected subject or expected run is missing or if any required subject analysis does not return status OK.
frozen_parameters.shared_subspace_control: State contrasts are accompanied by shared-subspace controls where documented

primary_predictions.statement: The high-gamma and broadband observables differ in the branching-related statistic under the declared intracranial analysis pipeline.

The historical proximity-score analysis shows a cross-subject association with the branching-related statistic. This artifact is retained for provenance and must not be relabeled as the final manuscript ND score without recomputation.
Minimum eigenvalue spacing differs between Propofol sedation and wakefulness under the declared fitted-operator pipeline.
Minimum eigenvalue spacing differs between rapid-eye-movement sleep and N3 within the ANPHY-Sleep cohort under the declared pipeline.
Spectral radius shows a pre-boundary shift before N2-to-N3 onset that survives the documented non-overlapping-window validation.

secondary_predictions: Minimum eigenvalue spacing shows weak within-state association with alpha power in Propofol and delta power in sleep under the declared controls.
Shared-subspace Principal Component Analysis preserves the direction of the principal state-spacing contrasts.
Phase-randomized surrogate controls constrain interpretation of absolute spectral-sensitivity magnitude.
Geometry and conventional feature families can provide complementary within-cohort discrimination under nested leave-one-subject-out evaluation.
explicit_non_claims: No claim of mathematically exact exceptional points in neural tissue.
No claim that fitted operators identify the true neural dynamical generator.
No causal claim that fitted geometry controls conscious state or sleep transitions.
No claim that the Zurich ds004752 task contrasts independently replicate the primary state effects.
No claim that a within-cohort area under the curve of 1.00 in n=10 sleep subjects is an out-of-cohort generalization estimate.
open_alignment_items: Recompute the final manuscript ND subject-level analysis under an explicitly defined aggregation rule before attaching the historical r approximately 0.86 result to ND.
Verify end-to-end that the strict canonical broadband runner reproduces the historical broadband comparison from raw data.

leakage_policy.summary: Subject-preserving predictive splits, explicit aggregation, causal temporal features for future targets, frozen evaluation rules, and transparent exploratory labels.
